# Open Source Legal Templates on GitHub for AI

**Source:** https://www.instagram.com/reel/DeFjXe4AboQ/ · **Type:** Reel · **Author:** Keeran Jagadesan · **Saved:** 2026-10-05

**Why I saved it:** Legal

## Summary

A law firm released its core legal document templates under a Creative Commons Zero license on GitHub. These structured templates, covering NDAs, privacy policies, and offer letters, can be supplied as context to AI models like Claude to generate custom legal documents.
